name: Zerhun
overview:
The family’s eldest son, Yaman Şerzanoğulları, is a just, principled, and compassionate man—unlike his father, Şeyhmuz. Yaman marries a woman his father does not approve of and turns his back on everything. However, his father’s pressure and schemes tear away the marriage he built on love and force him into another marriage approved by Şeyhmuz. Years later, Yaman learns that he has a daughter from his first wife. As he sets out in search of his former love and child, a terrible accident changes everything. Yaman loses his memory, his former wife Zerhun disappears, and their daughter Hayat is left in the middle of the devastation.

Zerhun’s mysterious disappearance, Hayat’s arrival at the Şerzanoğulları mansion, and the long-buried secrets that begin to surface one by one set off an irreversible chain of events within the family. Each secret brings a new conflict, and each confrontation uncovers a forgotten memory.
